instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check a person's answers against a form kept in the database and, when they are all valid, keep them with the score and segment they earn and any follow-up the form hands to its owner", and give it form_id (the saved form to answer); respondent_id (who is answering; answers of one respondent group together); answers (each question's answer, keyed by questionId).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:submit-form-answers and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: If any is invalid the first to fix is returned and nothing is kept. Otherwise one transaction keeps an answer fact for each answer the form asks about (table answer_fact), one segment assignment (segment_assignment) and one request row for each question whose afterSaved names an owner and action, with the answers filled into its input (owner_action_request), and the tool answers the decision (score and segment), the segment's follow-up sequence and the rows kept.
4. It keeps its rows in tables of your own database, reached only on the local port your computer reports as own-rows-postgres.

worked_examples.title: Check and decide a form's answers on its own sample
worked_examples.ask: Check a person's answers against a form kept in the database and, when they are all valid, keep them with the score and segment they earn and any follow-up the form hands to its owner
worked_examples.given: The input {"form_id":"sample-intake","respondent_id":"respondent-1","answers":{"budget":"2000"},"answered_at":"2026-06-26T00:00:00Z"} (the form was saved first with save-a-form, and the rules that decide the segment, if any, are rows of your score_rule, segment_rule and follow_up_sequence tables).
